score.description: 1 to 10: how well the delivered work fulfils the ORIGINAL REQUEST. 10 = nothing left to improve; 9 = fully meets the request, at most cosmetic nits; 7-8 = mostly there but with real gaps; 6 or less = significant problems or does not do what was asked.

fits_request.description: Does the result do what the original request asked for (not just what the plan says)?

summary.description: Two to four sentences justifying the score.

findings.description: What must change to bring the score to 9 or more. Required when score is below 9; may hold minor nits otherwise.

id.description: The id prefix given in the prompt followed by a number, e.g. C2-A1, C2-A2.

file.description: Repo-relative path, or empty string when not file-specific.

line.description: 1-based line in the new file, or 0 when not applicable.
